name: Interested in the spend-control ledger

title: "Ledger interest: "
labels: ledger-interest
---

Assay's own agents spend through a ledger that decides allow / deny / hold before any payment is signed,
applies hard caps no approval can lift, records a named approver on every exception, and writes a hash-chained
log that shows if anyone edits it afterwards. From that log it produces an evidence report.

If you'd use this for your own agents, tell us a little (all optional):

- What your agents pay for (model calls, data, x402 endpoints, other):
- Roughly how many agents or how much monthly spend, if you can say:
- What you use today for caps or approvals (none, wallet limits, agentpay, PaySentry, LiteLLM, your own):
- Who would read the evidence report (you, finance, an auditor, a client):
- Would you consider a paid two-week pilot? (yes / maybe / no)
